label: Task-19
title: Add Mermaid.js graph visualization option
description:
Add Mermaid.js as an alternative graph visualization library alongside D3.js.

## Why Mermaid.js?
- Declarative syntax (text-based graph definition)
- Built-in support for flowcharts, sequence diagrams
- Easy to export/share graph definitions
- Good for documentation and static views
- Widely used in markdown (GitHub, GitLab, etc.)

## Implementation
1. Add mermaid.js CDN to index.html
2. Create `graph-viewer-mermaid.js` component
3. Convert API response to Mermaid syntax:
   ```mermaid
   graph TD
     Feature-12 --> Task-14
     Feature-12 --> Task-15
     Task-15 --> Task-14
   ```
4. Add visualization mode toggle in graph-viewer toolbar
5. Support export of Mermaid code for documentation

## Pros
- Clean, readable output
- Easy to embed in docs
- Auto-layout (no manual positioning)

## Cons
- Less interactive than D3.js
- Limited customization of node positions
